package.label: Package to upgrade first (blank: the plan picks)

steps.title: Read release notes
steps.prompt: For each outdated package in {{run.dir}}/deps.json, read its release notes between the installed and latest versions. Write {{run.dir}}/NOTES.md: breaking changes and migration steps per package.

steps.title: Review and plan
steps.prompt: Review this repository for security issues, using {{run.dir}}/deps.json and {{run.dir}}/NOTES.md. Do not edit the repository. Write {{run.dir}}/security-report.md: each finding with severity, file, line, and reachable or not. Then plan one major upgrade at a time, starting with {{inputs.package}} if given, and name the findings each upgrade closes. Set package to the first package to upgrade. Set high_reachable to true when any high or critical finding is reachable, otherwise false.

steps.title: Bump and run the codemod
steps.prompt: Upgrade {{steps.plan.outputs.package}} as {{run.dir}}/security-report.md plans, in this worktree: bump it, run its codemod if one exists, apply the migration steps in {{run.dir}}/NOTES.md. Commit on the current branch. Do not push.

steps.title: Fix breakages
Approve the upgrade
steps.gate_summary: Hand back branch {{steps.bump.outputs.branch}} upgrading {{steps.plan.outputs.package}}. Tests passed: {{steps.check.outputs.passed}}. Reports: {{run.dir}}/security-report.md and {{run.dir}}/licence-report.md. The git push and gh pr create commands are handed back, not run.
